definitions.explanation: A demonstrative pronoun referring to something close to the listener, or something just mentioned.

examples.japanese: それを{取|と}ってください。
それは{私|わたし}のです。{返|かえ}してください。
examples.english: That's mine. Please give it back.

examples.japanese: それを{聞|き}いてうれしかったです。ずっと{知|し}りたかったので、よかったです。
examples.english: I was happy to hear that. I had been wanting to know, so I'm glad.

notes: それ refers to things near the listener or to information just mentioned in conversation. It's part of the ko-so-a-do system. When someone tells you something, you can respond with それはいいですね (that's good) or それは{大変|たいへん}ですね (that's tough). To modify nouns, use その instead.
